This week, in addition to unveiling the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo, Apple also launched an all-new iPhone wrist strap accessory. Here are the details.

Apple's brand-new wrist strap accessory can be paired with an iPhone case and AirPods Pro for use together

Apple continues to expand its iPhone accessory lineup, adding several new products.

In addition to the regular new cases for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo, the company has also introduced an all-new wrist strap accessory.

The wrist strap is designed to clip onto designated Apple iPhone cases and AirPods Pro, offering convenience while keeping your hands free to carry these products. The strap is meticulously crafted from 100% recycled PET yarn, ensuring comfort for all-day wear. Built-in flexible magnets help the strap stay snug and tidy.

The strap measures 15.4 inches long and is compatible with most official Apple cases for the iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max, and iPhone 17 series.

Available colors include wine red, light blue, olive green, taupe, magenta, and black.

This product can be described as a fairly straightforward new addition to Apple's accessory lineup. Equipped with the new wrist strap, you can comfortably and securely tether your iPhone and/or AirPods Pro to your wrist for enhanced protection.

You can order the Apple wrist strap from Amazon here for $29.

Third-party accessory manufacturers have offered similar products for years, but it is indeed a delight to see an official version from Apple.

Are you planning to order a wrist strap for your iPhone or AirPods? Feel free to leave a comment and let us know.
